title: Web client manage-mode GET /api/data discloses owner profile, control admin URL, and UNRAID_CSRF_TOKEN to non-owner/tagged tailnet peers
status: CONFIRMED by source inspection (authorizeRequest ordering + serveGetNodeData has no per-caller redaction)
upstream_status: UNFIXED on origin/main (no post-v1.104.1 commits touch client/web/web.go or auth.go)
severity_estimate: Medium (info disclosure). Preconditions: web client manage listener enabled; tailnet ACLs let the peer reach :5252.
mechanism: authorizeRequest (web.go): switch tests errNotUsingTailscale first, then `path==/api/data && GET` returns true BEFORE ownership/session checks. getSession returns errNotOwner/errTaggedRemoteSource/errTaggedLocalSource (NOT errNotUsingTailscale) for non-owner/tagged callers, so they fall through to the /api/data allow.
scenario: A different user's node, or a tagged node (which can never obtain a management session), reaches :5252 and GETs /api/data -> reads owner identity + admin URL + (on Unraid) the Unraid management-UI CSRF token (pivot to CSRF against the Unraid console).
note: Sessionless readonly /api/data is intentional, but exposing owner UserProfile and UNRAID_CSRF_TOKEN to arbitrary/tagged peers exceeds the read-only viewer intent.
fix: Require ownership for /api/data, or redact Profile/UnraidToken/ControlAdminURL when the caller has no authorized owner session.
